subtitle: 이중특성 신기 키운다는 닌자 성기사 참사

cuts.speaker: 트롤 주술사
cuts.dialogue:
강물터 크롤도크 보루에서
주문력 사슬 허리띠가 떴는데
징기가 입찰해서 먹었어?!
cuts.visual_prompt: 3.5-head-tall Korean gag webtoon style on a pure solid white #FFFFFF background, high-angle three-quarter shot. On the left, the troll shaman (staff stowed on her back) leans forward in wide-eyed shock, pointing an empty hand at an ornate interlocking silver ring-mesh mail-armor waist belt with metallic buckle (NOT prison chains) floating between them. On the right, the undead paladin (two-handed golden warhammer strapped to her back) smugly snatches the mail belt with a bored half-lidded smirk, minimal faint shadow beneath their boots.

cuts.speaker: 인간 흑마법사
cuts.dialogue:
다음 치유 반지는 나도 탐났지만
사제님 양보하려고 차비 눌렀거든?
근데 징기가 또 입찰로 채갔어!
cuts.visual_prompt: 3.5-head-tall Korean gag webtoon style on a pure solid white #FFFFFF background, dynamic over-the-shoulder view from behind the left character. On the left, the human warlock (grumpy red imp doll tucked under one arm) reaches her free hand toward a small floating brass greed-coin icon in dismay. On the right, the undead paladin (two-handed golden warhammer on her back) casually pockets a gleaming jeweled silver ring while tossing a chunky 6-sided white-and-gold cube showing ONLY classic round dot pips, strictly ZERO digits, ZERO numbers, ZERO letters. Hovering beside Human Warlock, her ultra-cute round squishy floating purple Voidwalker with glowing starry lavender belly and golden wrist bracers stares at the paladin's dice in wide-eyed disbelief.

cuts.speaker: 언데드 성기사
cuts.dialogue:
반지 필요 없으면 달라고요?
이중특성으로 신기 키울 때
써야 해서 못 드려요.
cuts.visual_prompt: 3.5-head-tall Korean gag webtoon style on a pure solid white #FFFFFF background, side-profile two-shot. On the left, the night elf priest (golden cleric staff strapped to her back) leans forward politely with both empty hands held out in an earnest pleading gesture and a hopeful sweat drop. On the right, the undead paladin (two-handed golden warhammer strapped to her back) crosses one arm and waves the other dismissively while wearing a flat unbothered expression, keeping the looted silver ring tucked in her palm.

3.5-head-tall Korean gag webtoon style on a pure solid white #FFFFFF background, dramatic low-angle reaction close-up. The human warlock on the left (red imp doll perched on her shoulder with its jaw dropped) and the night elf priest on the right (Priest's staff stowed on her back, hands frozen at their sides) stand utterly motionless with blank white pupils, pale faces, and heavy dark vertical shock lines looming over their heads in stunned silence. Floating beside Human Warlock, her ultra-cute round squishy floating purple Voidwalker with glowing starry lavender belly and golden wrist bracers also freezes pale with blank shocked eyes.

cuts.speaker: 인간 흑마법사
cuts.dialogue:
소문만 들을 땐 설마 했는데
직접 겪어보니까 진짜
인간혐오가 밀려오네…
cuts.visual_prompt: 3.5-head-tall Korean gag webtoon style on a pure solid white #FFFFFF background, tight dramatic upper-body shot centered in the frame. The human warlock slumps forward, pressing one empty palm over her forehead in sheer existential exhaustion while her grumpy red imp doll sits cross-legged on the floor beside her looking equally disappointed. Floating droopily beside Human Warlock, her ultra-cute round squishy floating purple Voidwalker with glowing starry lavender belly and golden wrist bracers pats her shoulder sympathetically.

cuts.speaker: 인간 흑마법사
cuts.dialogue:
앞으로 파티에 성기사 있으면 절대 안 간다!
내 파티에 들어오면 내가 나간다!!
cuts.visual_prompt: 3.5-head-tall Korean gag webtoon style on a pure solid white #FFFFFF background, wide side-angle comedic action shot. On the left, the furious human warlock (red imp doll clinging to her shoulder) bolts away toward the left edge kicking up comic dust puffs while clutching a glowing cyan Hearthstone in her raised hand. On the far right, the undead paladin (two-handed golden warhammer on her back) stands completely unfazed, giving a lazy half-hearted wave with one hand while admiring the silver ring on the other. Zooming hurriedly beside the fleeing Human Warlock, her ultra-cute round squishy floating purple Voidwalker with glowing starry lavender belly and golden wrist bracers puffs its cheeks in indignation.
